6. MODELS AND MODEL TERMS
6.1. Model Categories. The Services provide access to artificial intelligence models ("Models"). Models fall into two categories: (a) Models that Novita AI operates and manages on its own infrastructure ("Novita-Managed Models"); and (b) Models that are operated by a third party and made available to you through the Services by means of an interface to that third party's application programming interface ("Third-Party APIs"). Each provider of a Third-Party API is a "Model Provider". The license, acceptable use policy, data processing and privacy terms, output restrictions, and any other terms published or imposed by a Model Provider in respect of a Third-Party API are collectively the "Model Terms". A list of Third-Party APIs and links to the applicable Model Terms is maintained at novita.ai/models and may be updated from time to time.
6.2. Acceptance of Model Terms. By accessing or using any Third-Party API through the Services, you agree to be bound by the applicable Model Terms. You are solely responsible for reviewing the Model Terms applicable to each Third-Party API before use and for determining whether those Model Terms permit your intended use of the Services, your Inputs, and the resulting Outputs. Novita AI makes no representation that the Model Terms identified at the above URL are complete, current, or accurate, and you are responsible for verifying the applicable requirements directly with the relevant Model Provider.
6.3. Application of Model Terms. As between you and Novita AI, these Terms govern your use of the Services generally. The applicable Model Terms govern your access to and use of each Third-Party API to the extent required by the applicable Model Provider. Novita AI does not modify, waive, or limit any Model Terms unless expressly agreed by Novita AI in writing.
6.4. Data Handling for Third-Party APIs. Inputs and Outputs transmitted to or generated by a Third-Party API are processed by the applicable Model Provider on that Model Provider's own infrastructure and in accordance with the applicable Model Terms. Novita AI's data handling commitments under Section 10, including the Zero Data Retention policy set out in Section 10.2, apply solely to Novita AI's own handling of your Content and do not extend to any Model Provider. A Model Provider may log, retain, review, or use your Inputs and Outputs, including for model training, to the extent permitted by the applicable Model Terms. You are responsible for reviewing the applicable Model Terms before transmitting any confidential, personal, or regulated data to a Third-Party API.
6.5. Configuration and Model Selection. You are solely responsible for selecting the Third-Party APIs you access, configuring your account settings, setting permissions and restrictions for your authorized users and End Users, and determining whether each Third-Party API and the applicable Model Terms are appropriate for your intended use case, including any regulated, high-risk, sensitive, or customer-facing use.
6.6. Flow-Down to Authorized Users and End Users. If you access the Services on behalf of an organization, or if you build applications or services that enable third parties ("End Users") to interact with Models through the Services, you represent and warrant that:
(a) you have obtained all rights and authorizations necessary to enable such access in accordance with the applicable Model Terms;
(b) your agreement with your End Users imposes terms no less restrictive than the applicable Model Terms and these Terms with respect to permitted use of the Models and the Outputs; and
(c) you are responsible for your End Users' compliance, and any breach by an End User shall be deemed a breach by you.
6.7. Changes to Model Terms. Model Providers may modify their Model Terms at any time without notice to Novita AI or to you. Your continued use of a Third-Party API following any such modification constitutes your acceptance of the modified Model Terms.
6.8. Restricted Models. Certain Model Providers restrict access to their Models by reference to jurisdiction, entity type, sector, or end use ("Restricted Models"). You may not access or attempt to access a Restricted Model if you fall within a restricted category, and you may not use a virtual private network, proxy, false registration information, or any other means to circumvent such restrictions or any technical safeguard implemented by Novita AI or a Model Provider.
6.9. Provider Requirements. You will promptly provide any information, certifications, notices, consents, or other materials reasonably requested by Novita AI to confirm or support your compliance with applicable Model Terms, including any export control, sanctions, or end-user screening requirements imposed by a Model Provider. Your failure to provide such information may result in suspension or restriction of your access to the applicable Third-Party API or the Services.
6.10. Model Availability and Suspension. Novita AI reserves the right to add, modify, suspend, or remove any Model from the Services at any time, including where required by a Model Provider or by applicable law. Novita AI may suspend or terminate your access to any Third-Party API where Novita AI reasonably believes that your use violates or may violate the applicable Model Terms, or where the Model Provider so requires. Each Model Provider retains sole control over access to its Model. Novita AI does not warrant the availability, uptime, or performance of any Third-Party API and shall not be liable for any loss, damage, or disruption arising from the removal, modification, suspension, or unavailability of any Model.

AI-Generated Text Verification. When you apply for access to our text-verification tools, we collect your name, the email address associated with your Nebius Token Factory account, your country or region, your organisation or affiliation name and type, your Nebius Token Factory tenant ID, and information about your intended use of the tools, including the type of content you intend to check. Where relevant, this includes information about the EU AI Act obligations your organisation seeks to fulfil through verification. You may also provide your job title or role and your organisation or affiliation website. We use this information to assess your eligibility and administer access.
We also process information you provide in connection with verification requests, including any personal data contained in your submissions.

Text-Verification Records. When processing a verification request, we generate technical records that may include a verification reference, timestamps, a hash of the submitted text, the detector and tokenizer versions used, the verification result, and processing and deletion status. Requester or account identifiers are included only where necessary for the verification purposes described in Section 2.

AI-generated text verification: to assess eligibility for and administer access to our verification tools; check submitted text for technical markings indicating AI generation or manipulation; provide verification results; and communicate about verification requests.
